svg.title: coderprint: 639k lines of code in use, of 848k written, all time
svg.desc: 639,434 lines of code in use (441,975 in production, 197,459 in tests), of 847,614 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 2,809 commits across all branches, 51 active days, a longest streak of 36 days, a current streak of 36 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 772k lines of code. The bars end on 12OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 40%, Lean 32%, Python 14%, TypeScript 9%, JavaScript 4%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 75% is kept.
